title: The Aviary and Bill Moore's MUFON speech
summary: Jesse Michels tells of The Aviary and Bill Moore's MUFON speech, about 1980s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the aviary was this long rumored uh like it was like bird code names assigned to kind of disinfo agents around UFO related truth. So people like Rick Dodie, John Leer, uh it's kind of associated with Bill Moore and the agents where he made that muon speech

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the Aviary as a long-rumoured group in the 1980s whose members, all given bird code names, were said to spread false information about UFOs. He names people linked to it, such as Rick Doty and John Lear, and ties it to a researcher named Bill Moore and a speech Moore gave to MUFON, a civilian UFO research group, where he talked about these agents. If true, it would mean the UFO story was being deliberately muddied from the inside.
